note: The numbers every player agent is created with. They reach the client in the player block - the agent's create message carries the speed, and health and energy go out as agent properties - and the simulation advances the agent by the same speed. The reference hardcodes them in GameSrv_CreatePlayerAgent; here they are a file so the world states what it runs on.

speed.doc: How fast a player agent walks, in units a second. The client walks the model at the speed it is told, and the simulation advances the agent by the same number.

health.doc: The health a player agent starts with, sent as agent int-property 42 at load.

energy.doc: The energy a player agent starts with, sent as agent int-property 41 at load.

energy_regen.doc: The energy regeneration sent as agent float-property 43 at load. Zero is what the reference's own capture shows for a fresh agent: it never sets energy_per_sec.
